name: Tooltip
summary: A short description on hover and focus that satisfies all three parts of SC 1.4.13 — dismissible, hoverable, persistent — with the toggletip that touch users can actually reach beside it.
demoNote: Press Esc with the pointer still on a trigger, then move the pointer from a trigger onto its bubble — those two are what most tooltips fail. Example 3 is the native title attribute, kept as a comparison; example 4 is the version that works on a phone.
